'''Business and economy''' 
*[[Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war]]
**[[2026 Iranian strikes on Bahrain]]
***[[Bapco Energies]] declares [[force majeure]] on certain [[Oil refinery|refinery]] operations in [[Bahrain]] after damage to its facilities by [[Iran]]ian strikes, temporarily affecting shipments. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/gulf/2026/03/09/bahrain-s-bapco-declares-force-majeure-after-iran-strikes-statement (AFP via Al Arabiya)]
**[[Bangladesh]] closes all [[Universities in Bangladesh|universities]] by advancing the [[Eid al-Fitr]] holidays as part of emergency measures to reduce [[Electricity sector in Bangladesh|electricity consumption]] during an [[energy crisis]] linked to the [[2026 Iran war|Iran war]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/bangladesh-shuts-universities-early-save-power-amid-energy-crisis-2026-03-09/ (Reuters)]
**The [[Dow Jones Industrial Average]] and [[S&P 500]] rises after [[United States]] [[President of the United States|president]] [[Donald Trump]] says that the war in [[Iran]] is “very complete”, hinting that it could end soon. Additionally, oil prices have dipped under $100 following his remarks. [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/03/09/trump-iran-war-end.html (CNBC)] [https://www.semafor.com/article/03/09/2026/oil-prices-dip-under-100-as-trump-says-iran-war-very-complete (Semafor)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Azerbaijan–Iran relations]]
**[[2026 Iranian strikes on Azerbaijan]]
***[[Azerbaijan]] reopens [[Azerbaijan–Iran border|its border crossings]] with Iran to cargo traffic after closing them following a [[Unmanned aerial vehicle|drone]] incident in the [[Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic]]. [[President of Iran|Iranian president]] [[Masoud Pezeshkian]], who denies Iran's involvement, tells [[President of Azerbaijan|Azerbaijani president]] [[Ilham Aliyev]] that Iran is investigating the incident. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/azerbaijan-reopens-iran-border-cargo-traffic-after-drone-incident-tass-reports-2026-03-09/ (Reuters)]
*[[Greenland crisis]]
**[[NATO]] conducts military drills in [[Greenland]] involving over 25,000 troops from 14 nations including [[Denmark]] and the [[United States]] in a effort to de-escalate tensions over efforts by Trump to annex the island. The exercise will last until March 19. [https://www.the-independent.com/bulletin/news/nato-cold-response-greenland-us-denmark-b2934644.html (''The Independent'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Syrian civil war]], [[Syria–United Kingdom relations]]
**The [[Crown Prosecution Service]] charges a former [[Syria]]n [[Syrian military|soldier]] from the [[Air Force Intelligence Directorate]] with three counts of murder and three counts of [[torture]] as [[crimes against humanity]] under the [[International Criminal Court Act 2001|International Criminal Court Act]] for his attacks on civilians in [[Damascus]] in 2011. [https://apnews.com/article/syria-crimes-against-humanity-britain-damascus-2011-0caf8269792ec96ddcfac47caf4a6837 (AP)]
*[[Terrorism in Belgium]], [[Antisemitism in contemporary Belgium]] 
**A [[synagogue]] in [[Liège]], [[Belgium]], is damaged by an explosion. It is being investigated as a potential act of terrorism. [https://www.euronews.com/2026/03/09/historic-synagogue-in-liege-damaged-in-explosion-police-probe-cause (Euronews)]
*[[United States sanctions against Iran]]
**The [[United States]] reaches a [[deferred prosecution]] agreement with [[Turkey]]'s [[State-owned enterprises of Turkey|state-owned]] lender [[Halkbank]] to resolve criminal charges alleging that the bank helped Iran evade U.S. sanctions. Under the agreement, Halkbank must implement [[compliance monitoring]] and avoid transactions that benefit Iran, after which the charges may be dismissed pending [[Federal judiciary of the United States|court]] approval. [https://www.reuters.com/business/finance/turkeys-halkbank-us-justice-department-deferred-prosecution-agreement-judge-says-2026-03-09/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Colombian parliamentary election]]
**The ruling [[Historic Pact]] coalition wins 25 of 102 seats in the [[Senate of Colombia|Senate]], becoming the largest [[Parliamentary group|bloc]] but falling short of a [[Majority government|majority]]. The [[Democratic Centre (Colombia)|Democratic Centre]] places second with 17 seats, while other seats are distributed among several [[List of political parties in Colombia|parties]], resulting in a [[hung parliament]] that will require [[Coalition government|coalition]] negotiations. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/colombias-ruling-party-be-top-force-senate-without-majority-2026-03-09/ (Reuters)]
*[[2026 Kosovan presidential election]]
**The [[Constitutional Court of Kosovo|Constitutional Court]] of [[Kosovo]] issues an [[injunction]] that freezes [[President of Kosovo|President]] [[Vjosa Osmani]]'s decree [[Dissolution of parliament|dissolving]] the [[Assembly of the Republic of Kosovo|Kuvendi]], while also preventing both the President from calling [[snap elections]] and the Kuvendi from carrying out parliamentary business until the Constitutional Court delivers its final ruling.
